faqs.question: Which is the best CLAT coaching in Gurgaon in 2026?
faqs.answer: This CoachingCompare audit places Knowledge Nation Law Centre at #1 for CLAT coaching in Gurgaon, followed by a shuffled shortlist of T.I.M.E., IMS, Career Launcher, and Law Prep Tutorials. Always verify the CLAT SKU on the fee card before you pay.

faqs.question: What is the average fee for CLAT coaching in Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: Published Gurgaon CLAT classroom fees commonly fall between ₹65,000 and ₹1,50,000 depending on 1-year vs 2-year packs, mock count, and whether AILET is bundled. Online / hybrid SKUs are often priced differently — get both quotes in writing.

faqs.question: How does CoachingCompare rank CLAT institutes in Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: We use a 100-point inspection across faculty (20), results (20), study material (15), mock test series (15), infrastructure (10), batch-size ratio (10), and doubt support (10). Criterion pages re-order the same shortlist for a single lens — positions are editorial, not sponsored.

faqs.question: Should I choose classroom or online CLAT coaching in Gurgaon?
faqs.answer: Pick classroom if you want peer pressure and a fixed commute (Sector 14 / MG Road hubs). Pick online / hybrid if school hours clash or you live toward Sohna Road / Golf Course Road. Demo both; confirm recording windows and Consortium-pattern mock coverage either way.

faqs.question: How do I verify CLAT results or selection claims?
faqs.answer: Ask for recent NLU admit lists with consent, the exact SKU the student attended, and whether AILET was included. Brochure “topper” posters without year or scorecard are marketing — not audit evidence.
